IntroText: A girl with long red hair stands on the path like she owns the quiet.|Long red hair. Golden eyes. Crimson top, white shorts, black tights, combat boots.
She doesn't look away when you notice her.|Most people would.
Sidney.|(She offers the name only after she decides you earned it.)
Transfer weekend. Empty paths. Perfect for bad first impressions.|(Almost amused.)
You got the join kit.|(Her eyes go to the soft rope at your side. Not surprised.)
Here, rope isn't a secret. It's curriculum-adjacent.|(She says it like weather.)
I don't do long introductions.|(A step closer. Not touching yet.)
One of us walks away tied.|(Calm. Certain. Not theatrical.)
—hey!|(The rope bites. She tests it once
You actually committed.|(Breath uneven. Eyes brighter
Don't look so pleased.|(She is not begging. She is cataloguing.)
There.|(Your wrists settle. She checks the tension like practice.)
Standard issue works both ways.|(She steps back to see the whole picture.)
You handed it over. Remember that.|(Not gloating. Recording.)
I could leave you like this.|(A pause.) "I won't. Not on day one."
The rope is off. The day is not.|(She studies you one last time.)
